title: Prime Minister congratulates Ajay Kumar on winning Bronze at the Asian Para Games
body_text: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today congratulated Ajay Kumar for winning Bronze in the Men’s 400m T64 event at the Asian Para Games. Shri Modi stated that his performance on the track has brought another moment of pride for India, expressing hope that he continues to push boundaries and achieve greater success. In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared: "Congratulations to Ajay Kumar on winning Bronze in the Men’s 400m T64 event at the Asian Para Games! His performance on the track has brought another moment of pride for India. May he continue to push boundaries and achieve greater success: PM @narendramodi" Congratulations to Ajay Kumar on winning Bronze in the Men’s 400m T64 event at the Asian Para Games!
